localization.text: Bass from games, music and movies to your shakers. Uses the default Windows audio output.
While a game is running and SimHub is receiving its data, audio to the shakers pauses automatically. You can turn this off in Settings.
When SimHub receives data from a running game, Bass Relay automatically hands over the shakers to it (can be disabled in Settings)
Pause audio to all shakers while a game is running and SimHub is receiving its data, including gaps between effects. On by default.
Pause Bass Relay on all shakers until you choose Resume.
Bass Relay is manually paused. Choose Resume in Bass Relay.
Select the sound card for shaker {0}
Start with 20–80 Hz. Adjust to your shaker model and preference. Allowed range: 0–200 Hz. A lower limit of 0 disables the low-frequency cut.
Windows is currently using this card as its default output. Select another default output in Windows and the shaker will resume automatically.
Enter numbers from 0 to 200. The first must be lower than the second. Esc cancels changes.
Bass Relay — bass to your shakers
Bass Relay is still running in the system tray. Double-click its icon to open the window, or choose Exit to close the app.
Could not read settings. Using default settings.
Could not open Windows startup settings.
Could not determine the application path.
This device is the default Windows output. Duplication is disabled to prevent an audio loop. Select another default Windows output and the shaker will resume automatically.
Another shaker already uses this device. Select a different sound card or remove the duplicate.
Could not open audio devices. Will retry automatically. {0}
Device disconnected. Reconnect it to resume automatically.
Waiting for the default Windows output
Enter frequencies from 0 to 200 Hz. The first must be lower than the second.
A game is running and SimHub is receiving its data. Bass Relay has paused audio to all shakers. You can turn off auto-pause in Settings.
Another copy of Bass Relay is already processing audio. Close it to use this copy.
Waiting for the game status from SimHub. Audio is paused until the first update.
The Bass Relay plugin is stopped.
Could not start the Bass Relay plugin. {0}
Feel the bass from movies, music and other Windows audio through your cockpit shakers.
Pauses Bass Relay on all shakers until you resume. Windows sound and SimHub game effects continue.
Resume removes the manual pause. If automatic game pause is active, Bass Relay waits until the game stops.
Pause Bass Relay while a game is running in SimHub
Pauses Bass Relay on all shakers while SimHub detects a running game. Resumes when the game ends, unless paused manually.
Choose the audio outputs connected to your shaker amplifiers. Each output has its own vibration strength and frequency range.
Sound cards update automatically when connected or disconnected.
Waiting for the game status from SimHub
Choose a shaker sound card to start
Sending Windows audio to your shakers
Waiting for an available shaker output
How strongly this output vibrates. Start low and increase gradually.
Only bass within this frequency range reaches this output. Allowed range: 0–200 Hz; the lower value must be below the upper value.
Choose Not selected to remove this output. The last empty row remains available.
Vibration strength depends on the audio level captured from the main Windows output. Adjust the volume in your player or game first, then the shaker strength.
While this plugin is enabled, standalone Bass Relay closes and cannot start, even during pauses. Disable the plugin or exit SimHub to use the standalone app.
Waiting for standalone Bass Relay to close
Could not close standalone Bass Relay. Close it manually; the plugin will retry automatically.
